newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE--University N. Carolina Chapel Hill.
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE--University N. Carolina Chapel Hill.

text.p: The University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill
The Board of Governors of the University of North Carolina

SEALED BIDS will be received by the Board of Governors of The University of North Carolina (the Board'') at the General Administration Building, The University of North Carolina, 910 Raleigh Road, Chapel Hill, North Carolina, until 10:00 a.m., Eastern Daylight Time, on

at which time and place said bids will be publicly opened and read, for the purchase, at not less than 99.0% of par, of not less than all of The University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill Dining System Revenue Bonds, Series 1997 (the 1997 Bonds''). The 1997 Bonds shall mature as set forth in the Detailed Notice of Sale, in accordance with the bid submitted by the bidder offering to purchase the 1997 Bonds at the lowest true interest cost. A bid must be for not less than all of the 1997 Bonds of the issue and must be at least 99.0% of the aggregate principal amount of the 1997 Bonds. The bid for the 1997 Bonds must be accompanied by a certified or bank cashier's or treasurer's check for $136,950, payable to the order of the Board of Governors of The University of North Carolina, on which no interest will be allowed. The 1997 Bonds will be awarded on the basis of the lowest interest cost to Board. The lowest interest cost will be determined in accordance with the true interest cost (TIC) method by doubling the semiannual interest rate, compounded semiannually, necessary to discount the debt service payments from the payment dates to May 7, 1997 and to equal the price bid. There will be no auction. The 1997 Bonds maturing on or before May 15, 2007 are not subject to redemption prior to their stated maturities. The 1997 Bonds maturing after May 15, 2007 are subject to optional redemption in the manner provided in the Detailed Notice of Sale. The 1997 Bonds, together with the approving opinion of Parker, Poe, Adams & Bernstein L.L.P., Charlotte, North Carolina, Bond Counsel, will be delivered to The Depository Trust Company. Additional information, including the detailed notice of sale, may be obtained from the undersigned through Mr. Wayne R. Jones, Treasurer, The University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill, 300 South Building, Campus Box 1000, Chapel Hill, North Carolina 27599-1000; Telephone: (919) 962-3798; Fax: (919) 962-0647. The Board of Governors of the University of North Carolina
Jeffrey R. Davies, Associate Vice President-Finance
